recent.text: Final: Mammoth: 4, Avalanche: 1. The Mammoth end their six-game losing streak with a massive, hard-hitting win over their division opponent. This is exactly the type of win they needed. They worked hard to get this one. Cossa did too and more chants are coming. #TusksUp

recent.text: The Utah Mammoth's franchise-record losing streak ends at 6 games. Who would have thought they'd break it against Colorado, rather than Vancouver or San Jose? This was a fun night of hockey for the home crowd. Final score: 4-1 UTA #TusksUp #GoAvsGo
